pronunciationHelp.message: Correct how names, acronyms and specialist terms are spoken. Rules stay on this device and apply from the next reading, without changing the displayed text.

pronunciationMatchingHelp.message: Whole words and phrases match the paragraph’s language. Add plurals separately. Apostrophes and hyphens separate words; letters, digits and _ extend them. Accents matter. The longest phrase wins, then the case-sensitive rule. Personal rules take priority over built-in corrections, without cascading replacements.

pronunciationNumbersHelp.message: Grouped numbers are corrected automatically: 40 000 is read as “forty thousand”. Decimals follow the paragraph’s language; leading zeros and phone number groups are preserved.

pronunciationPreviewHelp.message: The preview uses the selected engine, voice and reading speed. It stops the current reading, without resuming it automatically.
